blocks.text: Aam taur par kaha jata hai ke electric current charge ka bahao (flow) hai. Dekhte hain ke conductor mein asal mein kya behta hai. Charge uthane wale (charge carriers) free electrons hain. Jab conductor ke sire battery ya kisi aur source se jore jayein to conductor ke andar har point par electric field ban jati hai. Free electrons par −E ki simt mein force lagti hai aur woh chalne lagte hain. Lekin electrons atoms se takrate rehte hain, is liye seedhi lakeer mein tez nahi hote. In takraon ka kul asar yeh hai ke electrons ki energy lattice (atoms ke dhanche) ko mil jati hai, aur electrons −E ki simt mein ek ausat (average) velocity hasil karte hain jise drift velocity kehte hain. Drift velocity taqreeban 10⁻³ m s⁻¹ ke darje ki hoti hai. Electrons ka yehi drift electric current banata hai. Dheemi drift velocity ka matlab yeh nahi ke current shuru hone mein der lagti hai: switch ON karte hi bulb foran jal jata hai.

Wajah yeh hai ke switch ON karte hi poore circuit ke saare free electrons ek saath drift karne lagte hain. Har electron padosi electrons ko dhakelta hai, aur yeh asar taar mein taqreeban foran phail jata hai. Isi liye current bohat tezi se shuru hota hai.
Agar waqt t mein conductor ke kisi cross-section se net charge Q guzre to current I:

Current ki SI unit ampere (A) hai: ek second mein ek coulomb charge guzre to current 1 A hai. Agar charges circuit mein hamesha ek hi simt mein chalein to current direct current (D.C.) kehlata hai; maslan battery D.C. deti hai. Agar charges pehle ek taraf aur phir ulti taraf chalein aur baqaida waqfon (regular intervals) se simt badlein to current alternating current (A.C.) kehlata hai. Zyada tar generators A.C. banate hain; power station se gharon, daftaron aur karkhanon ko aane wali bijli A.C. hai.

blocks.text: Dhaat ke taaron mein current electrons ke bahao se hota hai, magar purane scientists samajhte the ke current musbat charges ke bahao se hai. Scientists ne wahi riwayat (convention) qaim rakhi: current ki simt woh maani jati hai jidhar musbat charges chalte. Ise conventional current kehte hain.

blocks.title: Conventional current
blocks.text: Musbat charges ka woh farzi (hypothetical) bahao jo circuit mein wahi asar kare jo asal mein manfi charges (electrons) ka bahao karta hai.

Fig. 9.20 mein manfi electrons battery ke musbat terminal par pohanchte hain. Agar utna hi musbat charge musbat terminal se nikalta to bhi asar yehi hota. Is liye kehte hain ke conventional current musbat terminal se manfi terminal ki taraf behta hai (bahar wale circuit mein). Yeh hamare pehle tareeqe se milta hai jis mein field aur potential musbat test charge se samjhaye gaye the. Conventional current ki simt hamesha zyada potential se kam potential ki taraf hoti hai, yani + terminal se − terminal ki taraf. Ab se current I ka matlab hamesha conventional current hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar drift velocity sirf taqreeban 10⁻³ m s⁻¹ hai to switch ON karte hi bulb foran kyun jal jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Taar pehle hi free electrons se bhara hota hai. Switch ON karne se poore circuit mein electric field taqreeban foran ban jati hai, is liye bulb ke filament samet saare free electrons ek saath drift karne lagte hain; kisi electron ko switch se bulb tak safar nahi karna parta.

items: Free electrons −E ki simt mein taqreeban 10⁻³ m s⁻¹ ki drift velocity se chalte aur lattice se takrate hain; field foran phailti hai, is liye current foran shuru hota hai.
I = Q/t (9.28); 1 A = 1 C s⁻¹. D.C. ek simt (battery); A.C. simt badalta hai (generator, ghar ki supply).
Conventional current: musbat charge ka farzi bahao, zyada se kam potential ki taraf, electrons ke bahao ke ulat.
